name: pr_review_investigation
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

structured.description: Structured investigation result from the agent, expected shape {answer: string, review?: object}.

status.description: Agent turn status; only the literal 'success' (with a non-blank structured.answer) counts as a successful investigation.

error.description: Error detail folded into the placeholder answer when the turn did not succeed.

sessionId.description: This turn's agent session ID. Used verbatim when non-blank; otherwise priorSessionId is kept.

priorSessionId.description: Session ID carried over from the previous investigation pass, used when sessionId is absent.

question.description: The question asked in this investigation turn; recorded as-is in the returned history entry.

priorReview.description: The previously computed review, preserved unchanged when this turn fails or returns no review.

history.description: Prior investigation history entries; this turn's entry is appended to them.

priorTokens.description: Cumulative LLM tokens used before this turn; added to tokens for the new running total.

tokens.description: LLM tokens consumed by this investigation turn.

priorCost.description: Cumulative USD cost before this turn; added to cost for the new running total.

cost.description: USD cost of this investigation turn.

answer.description: The resolved answer text: the agent's answer on success, or a placeholder noting the failure/error while the prior review is preserved.

review.description: Summarized review ({summary, verdict, comments}) when this turn succeeded and returned a review; otherwise the unchanged priorReview.

sessionId.description: Resolved session ID: this turn's sessionId if non-blank, else priorSessionId, else empty string.

history.description: Prior history entries plus this turn's {pass, question, answer, status} entry.

count.description: Number of investigation passes recorded so far, including this one.

tokenUsed.description: Running total of LLM tokens used (priorTokens + tokens).

costUsd.description: Running total of USD cost (priorCost + cost).
